executionEnvironment: Docker Linux arm64 under Xvfb (no window manager)

checks.title: Packaged Avalonia desktop startup
checks.notes: The self-contained package opened its real X11 launcher and remained alive.

checks.title: Unicode input and output through the managed renderer
checks.notes: UTF-8 Japanese, Ukrainian, emoji, and a combining accent round-tripped through X11 clipboard paste, the terminal input contract, the PTY, and shell output.

checks.title: Unicode glyph fallback and terminal-cell fidelity
checks.notes: The UTF-8 byte roundtrip does not prove glyph availability, fallback, combining-mark placement, emoji width, or double-width cell behavior. The captured terminal image requires explicit visual review.

checks.title: X11 viewport to PTY grid resize
Interactive less TUI through the packaged renderer
checks.notes: less entered an interactive screen, accepted PageDown and q, then returned control to the shell.

checks.title: Alternate-screen entry and restoration
checks.notes: The real PTY fixture completed without crashing and before/after screenshots were captured, but this runner does not use OCR or a screen-snapshot API to assert restoration. Manual review is still required.

checks.title: SGR mouse reporting through X11 and the PTY
checks.notes: Captured 5 SGR reports; required press, release, drag, and wheel reports were present.

checks.title: Unsafe multiline paste confirmation
checks.notes: A multiline paste stayed pending, Escape cancelled it without execution, and an explicitly confirmed paste executed exactly once.

checks.title: Brokerless OSC 52 clipboard write policy
checks.notes: The managed adapter has no safe process-originated clipboard broker; its documented contract discarded OSC 52 and preserved the existing clipboard.

checks.title: Brokerless OSC 52 clipboard read response
checks.notes: Unit conformance covers the empty denial response, but this packaged run did not capture process-side bytes for an OSC 52 query.

checks.title: Xvfb cross-client Quick Terminal grab and Escape dismissal
checks.notes: Super+grave opened Quick Terminal while a different X11 client had focus on the same Xvfb server, and the transient Escape grab dismissed it. This result is scoped to the named Xvfb system.

checks.title: Normal desktop and child PTY lifecycle
checks.notes: Desktop exit code: 0; surviving captured descendants: [].

checks.title: Physical desktop or compositor global-hotkey behavior
checks.notes: A successful cross-client passive grab on Xvfb would not prove behavior under a physical desktop, window manager, compositor, or desktop shortcut policy.

checks.title: IME preedit, candidate placement, and committed composition
checks.notes: Xvfb has no desktop input-method compositor. Unicode clipboard/input coverage does not prove IME composition.

checks.title: Physical X11 desktop and compositor behavior
checks.notes: This named system is an Xvfb server inside an arm64 Docker VM, not a physical/self-hosted X11 desktop. Window-manager focus, compositor effects, and human interaction remain unproven.

checks.title: Host sleep and wake recovery
checks.notes: A Docker/Xvfb container cannot suspend and resume the named physical host.
